messages:
Eli: Quick check-inwe need final microcopy and CTA routing for the three product modes. Goal: clear activation paths + measurable funnels.
Nora: I can draft concise hero lines and one-liners for the micro-badges. aiming for outcome-first phrasing.
Diego: Ill own analytics mapping and the HubSpot field list. will share sample event names.
Rina: Proposed hero variants (very short):
- Hosted: "Ship LLM features fast  low friction, hosted inference with streaming and predictable pricing."
- Dedicated: "Dedicated GPU pools  reserved throughput, enterprise SLAs."
- Private: "Run inference in your network  VPC or on-prem, with audited controls.

Rina: Micro-badges (1-line):
Hosted: "Start free trial  benchmarked low-latency paths."
Dedicated: "Predictable throughput  SLA-backed performance."
Private: "Compliance-ready  KMS, audit logs, on-prem options."

Owen: CTA mapping proposal:
- Hosted hero CTA -> /trial (event: hosted_trial_started)
- Hosted secondary -> /benchmarks (event: hosted_bench_view)
- Dedicated hero CTA -> /demo (event: demo_request)
- Dedicated secondary -> /capacity-guide (event: capacity_guide_dl)
- Private hero CTA -> /contact-sales (event: private_inquiry)
- Private secondary -> /compliance-whitepaper (event: compliance_dl)

Diego: Adding priorities: demo & private inquiries = P1 (AE alert + 2hr SLA), capacity-guide downloads = P2 nurture, hosted trial signups = P2 auto-onboard.
Zoe: Webinar idea: "Inference cost & scale playbook"  show Hosted benchmark highlights and a Dedicated sizing case study. CTA from site -> register.
Nora: Social caption (short): "New from Redwood: predictable, production-grade inference across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Join our webinar to see real benchmarks & migration tips."
Eli: A/B experiment: swap Hosted hero primary CTA between [Start free] and [View benchmarks] for 50/50. Measure 7-day activation rate and MQL conversion.
Diego: Analytics plan draft:
- cohort_id for A/B variant
- event: hero_cta_click (label: start_free|view_bench)
- downstream events: trial_setup_complete, first_api_call, demo_booked
- key metric: trial->active within 7d, demo->sales_qualified

Rina: Microcopy tweak for Private lead forms: add small datapoint: "We support enterprise KMS & audit logs; we do not read model inputs." keeps compliance teams comfortable.
Owen: For benchmarks on the page  propose two short stats + link to deep dive: Hosted median p99 token latency, Dedicated sustained RPS with 99.95% uptime. format as compact badges.
Zoe: Webinar promo plan: email to mid-market + enterprise lists, organic social, and paid retargeting for landing visitors who view benchmark page.
Eli: Timing: finalize copy by EOD Thu, design assets Fri morning, dev staging deploy Sat, smoke tests Sun, public Monday.
deploy-bot: Heads-up: staging deploy scheduled for timestamp 1723460000; will run smoke tests after.
Diego: I'll push the GTM event sheet and HubSpot mapping by EOD.
Nora: I'll post final hero + badge text here when done. keeping lines <100 chars.
Rina: Also adding a tiny FAQ link under Private CTA: "How is data handled?" -> fragments about encryption, audit logs, on-prem install.
Eli: Thanks all. next steps: Nora final copy, Diego analytics, Owen CTAs, Zoe webinar landing. closing unless blockers.
